createOrReplace.title: Mechanical Engineering MEng (H301) | Imperial
createOrReplace.excerpt: Start date October 2027, UCAS H301. A-levels Minimum entry standard A*A*A or A*AAA. To include: A* in Mathematics, A/A* in Physics (A* is required if applying with three A-levels), A in a third and/or fourth subject. Typical offer A*A*A* (three A-levels). International Baccalaureate Minimum entry standard 40 points, to include 6 in Mathematics at higher level, 6 in Physics at higher level; Typical offer 40 points with 7 in HL Mathematics and 7 in HL Physics. Admissions test (ESAT) and interview. US: EITHER 5,5,5,5,5 overall, to include Calculus BC and Physics C (Mechanics) OR 5,5,5 to include Calculus BC and Physics C (Mechanics), plus US High School Diploma and either 1480 in SAT or 33 in ACT. Home fee 2027 entry £10,050 per year; Overseas fee 2027 entry £47,800 per year.

createOrReplace.excerpt: UCAS course code G401. A-levels Minimum entry standard A*A*A – A*AAA. International Baccalaureate Minimum entry standard 41 points, to include 7 in Mathematics at higher level, 7 in another relevant subject at higher level; Typical offer 42 points.
